    pe.amount,

FROM payment_event pe

SELECT

    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    ind_borrower.sector_name_zh AS 借款人注册行业名称,
    ind_target.sector_name_zh AS 协议投向行业名称,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额

JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind_borrower ON op.industry_code = ind_borrower.sector_code

SELECT 
    p.payment_id,
    p.business_date,
    p.amount,
    ah_from.party_id AS payer_party_id,
    ah_to.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM payment_event p
JOIN account_holder ah_from 
    ON p.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN account_holder ah_to 
    ON p.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
WHERE p.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM party_relation pr
      WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
        AND (
            (pr.source_party_id = ah_from.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = ah_to.party_id)
            OR (pr.source_party_id = ah_to.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = ah_from.party_id)
        )
  )
ORDER BY p.amount DESC;

FROM payment_event pe
JOIN service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id

    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS 担保人数量

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN COALESCE(d.principal_overdue_days, 0) = 0 THEN '未逾期'
    WHEN COALESCE(d.principal_overdue_days, 0) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30天'
    WHEN COALESCE(d.principal_overdue_days, 0) BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '31-90天'
    WHEN COALESCE(d.principal_overdue_days, 0) BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN '91-180天'
    WHEN COALESCE(d.principal_overdue_days, 0) BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN '181-360天'
    ELSE '360天以上'
  END AS overdue_interval,
  COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown l
LEFT JOIN delinquency_snapshot d ON l.loan_id = d.loan_id AND d.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY overdue_interval
ORDER BY 
  CASE overdue_interval
    WHEN '未逾期' THEN 0
    WHEN '1-30天' THEN 1
    WHEN '31-90天' THEN 31
    WHEN '91-180天' THEN 91
    WHEN '181-360天' THEN 181
    ELSE 361
  END;

    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rel.relation_id IS NOT NULL THEN pe.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS related_party_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount,
