    AND rel.target_party_id = th.party_id
    AND rel.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
LEFT JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = COALESCE(fa.institution_id, ta.institution_id)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY related_party_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS 持有贷记卡数量,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS 定期存款账户数量
FROM party p
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = ah.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 定期存款账户数量 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       ROUND(AVG(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.disbursed_on)), 2) AS avg_age_days
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY avg_age_days DESC;

WITH latest_balance AS (
    SELECT
        lbs.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lbs.loan_id ORDER BY lbs.as_of_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date <= '2026-06-30'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC) AS quartile_group
    FROM latest_balance
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    loan_id,
    ROUND(principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    quartile_group
FROM ranked
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH industry_balance AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(ins.sector_name_zh, '其他行业') AS industry_name,
        ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
    LEFT JOIN industry_sector ins ON ins.sector_code = op.industry_code
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY COALESCE(ins.sector_name_zh, '其他行业')
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        industry_name,
        total_balance,
        ROUND(SUM(total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY total_balance DESC, industry_name
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) * 1.0
              / SUM(total_balance) OVER (), 6) AS cumulative_ratio
    FROM industry_balance
)
SELECT
    industry_name,
    total_balance,
    cumulative_ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE cumulative_ratio <= 0.8
ORDER BY cumulative_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.borrower_party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 未结清借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id, ca.institution_id, p.display_name, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY COUNT(ld.loan_id) DESC;

WITH latest_valuation AS (
    SELECT collateral_id, valuation_amount,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY collateral_id ORDER BY valued_on DESC, valuation_amount DESC) AS rn
    FROM collateral_valuation
)
SELECT sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
       sa.secured_amount AS 担保债权金额,
       cl.collateral_id AS 抵押物编号,
       lv.valuation_amount AS 最新评估价值
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN latest_valuation lv ON cl.collateral_id = lv.collateral_id AND lv.rn = 1
WHERE lv.valuation_amount > 2 * sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY (lv.valuation_amount - sa.secured_amount) DESC;

SELECT p.party_id AS 客户编号,
       p.display_name AS 客户名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS 开户机构家数
FROM party p
JOIN account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) > 1
ORDER BY 开户机构家数 DESC;

SELECT from_account_id AS 账户编号,
       business_date AS 交易日期,
       COUNT(*) AS 交易笔数
FROM payment_event
WHERE from_account_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY from_account_id, business_date
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY 交易笔数 DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id) AS 集团成员户数,
       ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 余额合计
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exposure_group_member egm WHERE egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 担保人编号,
    p.display_name AS 担保人名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT g.security_id) AS 担保合同数量,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 担保金额合计
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT g.security_id) > 1 AND SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY 担保金额合计 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT lbs.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_since IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(lbs.overdue_since) AS INTEGER) >= 90
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    bp.display_name AS 借款方名称,
    pi.instruction_amount AS 指令金额,
    pp.display_name AS 收款方名称
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_instruction pi ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party bp ON bp.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN party pp ON pp.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND pi.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 合同编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款方名称,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN party_type_catalog ptc ON p.party_type = ptc.party_type
JOIN status_catalog sc ON sc.entity = 'party' AND sc.status_code = p.status
WHERE ptc.name_zh = '对公客户'
  AND sc.name_zh = '冻结'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    lpc.product_name_zh,
    ind.sector_name_zh,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON ld.drawdown_type = lpc.product_code
JOIN industry_sector ind ON ca.target_industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE lpc.product_family = 'WORKING_CAPITAL'
  AND ind.risk_category = 'EXIT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(avg_bal.avg_principal_balance, 2) AS institution_avg_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - avg_bal.avg_principal_balance, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca2.institution_id,
        AVG(lbs2.principal_balance) AS avg_principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld2
    JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON ld2.agreement_id = ca2.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 ON ld2.loan_id = lbs2.loan_id
    WHERE lbs2.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca2.institution_id
) avg_bal ON ca.institution_id = avg_bal.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 2 * avg_bal.avg_principal_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ca.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT pr.source_party_id
        FROM party_relation pr
        JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
        WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方'
    ) THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS non_related_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ca.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT pr.source_party_id
        FROM party_relation pr
        JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
        WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方'
    ) THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ca.contract_amount), 6) AS ratio
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = ca.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS 执行年利率,
    ROUND(avg_rate.avg_rate, 4) AS 所属目标行业平均利率,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - avg_rate.avg_rate) * 100.0 / avg_rate.avg_rate, 2) AS 较行业平均上浮百分比
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT target_industry_code, AVG(annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement
    WHERE target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
      AND annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY target_industry_code
) avg_rate ON avg_rate.target_industry_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.annual_interest_rate > avg_rate.avg_rate * 1.1
ORDER BY 较行业平均上浮百分比 DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS over_limit_customer_count
FROM (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
) p
JOIN party pt ON p.party_id = pt.party_id AND pt.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
JOIN institution i ON p.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = p.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE p.total_principal_balance > 0.1 * cs.net_capital
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY over_limit_customer_count DESC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_balance,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs
    ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.maturity_on,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'MATURED'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    ROUND(pe.amount, 2) AS amount,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_interval
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_event pe
    ON pe.from_account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc
    ON ptc.payment_type = pe.payment_type
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND ptc.payment_type = 'TRANSFER'
  AND pe.business_date >= ld.disbursed_on
  AND julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) <= 7
ORDER BY days_interval ASC, pe.amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH corp_loan_balance AS (
    SELECT
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
capital AS (
    SELECT institution_id, net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
),
ratio_calc AS (
    SELECT
        clb.institution_id,
        clb.borrower_party_id,
        ROUND(clb.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / c.net_capital, 6) AS ratio
    FROM corp_loan_balance clb
    JOIN capital c ON c.institution_id = clb.institution_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        rc.institution_id,
        rc.borrower_party_id,
        rc.ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rc.institution_id ORDER BY rc.ratio DESC) AS rn
    FROM ratio_calc rc
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name,
    r.ratio
FROM ranked r
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = r.borrower_party_id
WHERE r.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        lbs.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ca.institution_id,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY ca.institution_id ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS quartile
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
    loan_id,
    ROUND(principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    quartile
FROM ranked
ORDER BY quartile ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    lb.loan_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance * 100.0 / SUM(lb.principal_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY i.institution_id), 2) AS pct
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lb.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC, pct DESC, lb.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS 累计放款金额,
    ld.status AS 借据状态,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计,
    COUNT(*) AS 逾期期次数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.status
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 逾期期次数 DESC, 逾期本金合计 DESC, 借据编号 ASC;

SELECT
    loan_account_id AS 放款账户编号,
    disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    COUNT(loan_id) AS 放款借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown
GROUP BY loan_account_id, disbursed_on
HAVING COUNT(loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 放款借据笔数 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT p.party_id
FROM party p
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY p.party_id ASC;

SELECT p.party_id
FROM party p
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'STAFF'
  AND sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM account_holder ah
      WHERE ah.party_id = p.party_id
  )
ORDER BY p.party_id ASC;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM payment_event pe
      WHERE pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
        AND pe.payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT security_id, guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment
WHERE status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') < 0 THEN '已到期'
        WHEN julianday(ld.current_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 90 THEN '临期'
        ELSE '常态'
    END AS maturity_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
GROUP BY maturity_bucket
ORDER BY CASE maturity_bucket
    WHEN '常态' THEN 1
    WHEN '临期' THEN 2
    WHEN '已到期' THEN 3
END;

SELECT cl.collateral_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS related_count
FROM collateral_link cl
JOIN security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) > 1
ORDER BY related_count DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_type AS collateral_type,
    ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS avg_valuation_amount,
    COUNT(cv.valuation_id) AS valuation_count
FROM collateral_valuation cv
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY avg_valuation_amount DESC;

WITH loan_repay_account AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.repayment_account_id AS account_id,
        ld.disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
),
account_loan_count AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) AS loan_cnt
    FROM loan_repay_account
    GROUP BY account_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) >= 3
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        lra.account_id,
        lra.loan_id,
        lra.disbursed_on,
        lra.disbursed_amount,
        alc.loan_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lra.account_id
            ORDER BY lra.disbursed_on ASC, lra.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_repay_account lra
    JOIN account_loan_count alc
        ON lra.account_id = alc.account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    loan_id,
    disbursed_on,
    ROUND(disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
    loan_cnt
FROM ranked_loans
WHERE rn <= 2
ORDER BY account_id ASC, disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount, 2) AS excess_amount,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count,
    ROUND(SUM(abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance), 2) AS total_difference
FROM account_balance_snapshot abs
JOIN account a ON abs.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE abs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND abs.available_balance IS NOT NULL
  AND abs.ledger_balance > abs.available_balance
  AND (abs.ledger_balance - abs.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_difference DESC;

SELECT
    td.account_id,
    td.opening_principal,
    td.maturity_on,
    td.annual_interest_rate
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT card_id, card_type, issued_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'DEBIT'
  AND issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY issued_on ASC, card_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS entrusted_payment_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS self_payment_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6) AS entrusted_payment_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode IN ('ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT', 'SELF_PAYMENT')
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6) < 0.52
ORDER BY entrusted_payment_ratio ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ld.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS 单笔放款金额,
    ROUND(t.total_amount, 2) AS 合同内累计放款金额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / t.total_amount, 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN (
    SELECT agreement_id, SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown
    GROUP BY agreement_id
) t ON t.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / t.total_amount > 0.9
ORDER BY ld.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(w.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS total_actual_raise,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN w.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_planned_raise,
    ROUND(SUM(w.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN w.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 6) AS completion_rate
FROM wealth_product w
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = w.issuer_institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN w.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND SUM(w.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN w.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) > 1.2
ORDER BY completion_rate DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 借款人编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) AS 逾期借据笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 全部借据笔数
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status <> 'OVERDUE' OR rs.status IS NULL THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
ORDER BY 逾期借据笔数 DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    ROUND(pi.instruction_amount, 2) AS instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
JOIN party payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE pi.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id <> ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.signed_on,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.signed_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    rs.loan_id,
    COUNT(*) AS unsettled_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_principal_due
FROM repayment_schedule rs
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
ORDER BY total_principal_due DESC, rs.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.opened_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE a.opened_on IS NOT NULL
  AND ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.account_kind,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.security_type,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE ca.security_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p.party_id AS borrower_party_id,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS annual_interest_rate,
    ROUND(avg_rate.avg_rate, 4) AS avg_rate_same_inst_product,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate - avg_rate.avg_rate, 4) AS rate_spread
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca2.institution_id, ca2.product_family, AVG(ca2.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca2
    WHERE ca2.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca2.institution_id, ca2.product_family
) avg_rate
  ON avg_rate.institution_id = ca.institution_id
 AND avg_rate.product_family = ca.product_family
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.annual_interest_rate < avg_rate.avg_rate
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM party_relation pr
      JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
      WHERE (pr.source_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id OR pr.target_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id)
        AND rtc.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
  )
ORDER BY rate_spread DESC;

SELECT
    pr.source_party_id AS source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id AS target_party_id,
    rtc.relation_name_zh AS relation_name
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc
    ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE pr.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM credit_agreement ca
      JOIN loan_drawdown ld
          ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
      WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM credit_agreement ca
      JOIN loan_drawdown ld
          ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
      WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
  )
ORDER BY rtc.relation_name_zh ASC, pr.relation_id ASC;

SELECT
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN capital_snapshot cs
    ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 2
   AND SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.1
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    payer.display_name AS payer_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pe.payment_id) AS transfer_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc
    ON ptc.payment_type = pe.payment_type
   AND ptc.name_zh = '转账'
JOIN account_holder ah_from
    ON ah_from.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_to
    ON ah_to.account_id = pe.to_account_id
JOIN party payer
    ON payer.party_id = ah_from.party_id
JOIN party payee
    ON payee.party_id = ah_to.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr
    ON pr.source_party_id = ah_from.party_id
   AND pr.target_party_id = ah_to.party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc
    ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
   AND rtc.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方'
GROUP BY payer.display_name, payee.display_name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs
    ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma
    ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
ORDER BY wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot
WHERE investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    lb.loan_id,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    MAX(d.principal_overdue_days) AS max_overdue_days
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
JOIN delinquency_snapshot d
    ON d.loan_id = lb.loan_id
WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lb.principal_balance > 90000000
  AND lb.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY lb.loan_id, lb.principal_balance
HAVING MAX(d.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY max_overdue_days DESC, lb.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS institution_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY institution_count DESC;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS overdue_member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
   AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 企业名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(COALESCE(g.guarantee_total, 0), 2) AS 对外担保合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(l.loan_total, 0), 2) AS 自身借款合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(g.guarantee_total, 0) - COALESCE(l.loan_total, 0), 2) AS 担保负债差额
FROM party p
JOIN (
    SELECT gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id, SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS guarantee_total
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
) g ON g.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id, SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS loan_total
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) l ON l.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND COALESCE(g.guarantee_total, 0) > COALESCE(l.loan_total, 0)
ORDER BY 担保负债差额 DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    sm.staff_id AS staff_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS agreement_count
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sm.staff_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY agreement_count DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
    ROUND(pp.annual_income, 2) AS 年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 2
ORDER BY 倍数 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    so.operator_id AS 操作员编号,
    so.authority_level AS 权限级别,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 自贷合同数
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE so.operator_kind = 'CREDIT_OFFICER'
GROUP BY p.display_name, so.operator_id, so.authority_level
ORDER BY 自贷合同数 DESC

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS 放款金额,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN party_type_catalog ptc ON ptc.party_type = p.party_type
WHERE ptc.party_type = 'STAFF'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 借款人客户编号,
    pp.annual_income AS 个人年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due), 2) AS 应还本息总额,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 占年收入倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
ORDER BY 占年收入倍数 DESC, 借款人客户编号 ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    lpc.product_name_zh AS product_name,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON ld.drawdown_type = lpc.product_code
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY lpc.product_name_zh
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND td.maturity_on <= DATE('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_90_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > DATE('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_90_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY expired_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ah.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM account_holder ah
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ah.party_id) > 1
ORDER BY joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lbs.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = ca.managing_org_unit_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    rs.loan_id,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING SUM(rs.principal_due) > 120000000
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.interest_due), 2) AS total_interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(rs.installment_id) >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC;

SELECT
    loan_id,
    installment_no,
    ROUND(principal_due, 2) AS principal_due,
    ROUND(interest_due, 2) AS interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule
WHERE status = 'OVERDUE'
  AND principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY principal_due DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(COALESCE(facility_total.limit_sum, 0), 2) AS total_limit_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(drawdown_total.disbursed_sum, 0), 2) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    ROUND(cap.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(COALESCE(drawdown_total.disbursed_sum, 0) * 1.0 / cap.net_capital, 4) AS disbursed_to_capital_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN (
    SELECT institution_id, SUM(net_capital) AS net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY institution_id
) cap ON cap.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT institution_id, SUM(limit_amount) AS limit_sum
    FROM credit_facility
    GROUP BY institution_id
) facility_total ON facility_total.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ca.institution_id, SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS disbursed_sum
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
) drawdown_total ON drawdown_total.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE COALESCE(drawdown_total.disbursed_sum, 0) > cap.net_capital
ORDER BY disbursed_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc
    ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    cf.facility_id,
    ROUND(cf.limit_amount, 2) AS limit_amount,
    sc.name_zh AS status_name
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN status_catalog sc
    ON sc.entity = 'credit_agreement'
   AND sc.status_code = cf.status
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
ORDER BY cf.limit_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_limit_amount
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
GROUP BY cf.institution_id, i.institution_name, cf.facility_type
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY total_limit_amount DESC;

SELECT facility_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM credit_facility
WHERE limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY facility_type
ORDER BY record_count DESC

SELECT
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh AS payment_mode_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc
    ON ld.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        minimum_holding_days,
        actual_raise_amount,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS grp
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ON_SALE'
)
SELECT
    grp AS 分组序号,
    COUNT(*) AS 产品数量
FROM ranked
WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
GROUP BY grp
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY grp ASC;

SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS total_revolving_limit,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS disbursement_count
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.facility_id = cf.facility_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
  AND ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
GROUP BY cf.facility_id
ORDER BY total_revolving_limit DESC;

SELECT pmc.payment_mode_name_zh AS 支付方式中文名称,
       COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS 待执行指令数量
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pi.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 待执行指令数量 DESC;

SELECT it.name_zh AS instrument_type_name, sc.name_zh AS status_name
FROM instrument_type_catalog it
CROSS JOIN status_catalog sc
WHERE sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY it.name_zh, sc.name_zh;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.staff_id) AS credit_manager_count
FROM staff_assignment sa
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = sa.org_unit_id
WHERE sa.role_code = 'CREDIT_MANAGER'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY credit_manager_count DESC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    ROUND(ds.overdue_principal, 2)
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 30
  AND cg.grade_code = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.loan_id) AS under_provisioned_loan_count
FROM provision_snapshot p
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND p.provision_stage = 'STAGE_2'
  AND p.required_amount > 0
  AND ROUND(p.recognized_amount * 1.0 / p.required_amount, 6) < 0.5
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY under_provisioned_loan_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS provision_gap
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY provision_gap DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.account_subtype, abs.ledger_balance
FROM account a
JOIN account_balance_snapshot abs ON abs.account_id = a.account_id AND abs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE a.status = 'DORMANT'
  AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM account_holder ah
      WHERE ah.account_id = a.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
  )
ORDER BY abs.ledger_balance DESC;

SELECT p.customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM person_profile pp
JOIN party p ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
    ma.asset_category_primary AS asset_category_primary,
    COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN industry_sector ind
    ON ma.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE ind.risk_category = 'RESTRICTED'
GROUP BY ma.asset_category_primary
HAVING COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY asset_count DESC, asset_category_primary ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(pp.annual_income, 2) AS 年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 授信额度合计,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 偿债比
FROM party p
JOIN party_type_catalog ptc ON ptc.party_type = p.party_type
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.obligor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ptc.name_zh = '个人客户'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY 偿债比 DESC, 客户编号 ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM person_profile pp
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY pp.occupation_code, pp.employment_sector
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, pp.occupation_code ASC, pp.employment_sector ASC

SELECT
    pc.status AS card_status,
    COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '借记卡'
GROUP BY pc.status
ORDER BY card_count DESC, card_status ASC;

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
JOIN party p ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 金额合计 DESC, 营业单元名称 ASC;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id AS payment_id,
    pc.card_id AS card_id,
    pc.holder_party_id AS holder_party_id,
    pe.business_date AS business_date,
    ROUND(pe.amount, 2) AS amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a
    ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_card pc
    ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc
    ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    pc.holder_party_id AS holder_party_id,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS cash_txn_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN payment_event pe
    ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc
    ON ctc.card_type = pc.card_type
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(pe.payment_id) > 5
ORDER BY cash_txn_count DESC, total_amount DESC;

SELECT holder_party_id AS party_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY card_count DESC, party_id ASC;

SELECT
    c.name_zh AS card_type_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(p.amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM payment_event p
JOIN payment_card pc ON p.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog c ON pc.card_type = c.card_type
WHERE p.is_cash = 1
  AND pc.card_type IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT')
GROUP BY c.name_zh
ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, card_type_name ASC;

SELECT
    channel,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE status = 'SETTLED'
  AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY channel
HAVING AVG(amount) > 11780000
ORDER BY avg_amount DESC, channel ASC;

SELECT
    td.account_id,
    td.maturity_on,
    a.status
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(MAX(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS max_valuation_amount
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv
    ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cv.valuation_id) >= 2
ORDER BY max_valuation_amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS reference_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS distinct_security_count
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) >= 2
ORDER BY reference_count DESC, ca.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    ca.agreement_id AS agreement_id,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS guaranteed_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ld.total_disbursed, 0), 2) AS total_disbursed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT agreement_id, SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown
    GROUP BY agreement_id
) ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND gc.guaranteed_amount > COALESCE(ld.total_disbursed, 0)
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, p.party_id ASC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.borrower_party_id,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) AS total_covered_amount,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN security_agreement sa
    ON sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN secured_obligation so
    ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
    AND so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0) < ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS underprovisioned_loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE cg.grade_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'
  AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY underprovisioned_loan_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ca.borrower_party_id AS debtor_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS loan_balance,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS credit_amount,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS balance_multiple
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE lbs.principal_balance >= ca.contract_amount * 4
ORDER BY balance_multiple DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ps.loan_id) AS over_provision_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount), 2) AS over_provision_amount
FROM provision_snapshot ps
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY over_provision_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC, cg.grade_name_zh ASC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(internal_max.max_internal, 2) AS max_internal_value,
    ROUND(external_max.max_external, 2) AS max_external_value,
    ROUND(internal_max.max_internal - external_max.max_external, 2) AS undervaluation_gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN (
    SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_internal
    FROM collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'INTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
) internal_max ON internal_max.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN (
    SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valuation_amount) AS max_external
    FROM collateral_valuation
    WHERE valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL'
    GROUP BY collateral_id
) external_max ON external_max.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE external_max.max_external < internal_max.max_internal
ORDER BY undervaluation_gap DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(cv.valuation_amount, 2) AS latest_valuation_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 2) AS total_pledged_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(cl.pledged_amount) - cv.valuation_amount, 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_link cl
    ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
    AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN (
    SELECT collateral_id, valuation_amount
    FROM collateral_valuation cv1
    WHERE valued_on = (
        SELECT MAX(valued_on)
        FROM collateral_valuation cv2
        WHERE cv2.collateral_id = cv1.collateral_id
    )
) cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, cv.valuation_amount
HAVING SUM(cl.pledged_amount) > cv.valuation_amount
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(COALESCE(borrow.borrow_amount, 0), 2) AS 自身借款金额合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(guar.guarantee_amount, 0), 2) AS 对外保证金额合计
FROM party p
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id AS party_id, SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS borrow_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) borrow ON borrow.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT gc.guarantor_party_id AS party_id, SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS guarantee_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
) guar ON guar.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE guar.guarantee_amount > borrow.borrow_amount
ORDER BY 对外保证金额合计 DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc
    ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM party AS p
JOIN person_profile AS pp
    ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.is_public_official = 1
  AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    eg.group_type AS group_type_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name, eg.group_type
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 成员客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 所属集团数量 DESC, 成员客户编号 ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 主体编号,
    p.display_name AS 主体名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS 关联关系条数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款合同笔数
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr
    ON (pr.source_party_id = p.party_id OR pr.target_party_id = p.party_id)
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc
    ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
   AND rtc.relation_type <> 'NON_RELATED'
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联关系条数 DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr
    ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
    OR pr.target_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc
    ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
    AND rtc.relation_type = 'SHADOW_SHAREHOLDER'
JOIN exposure_group_member egm
    ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY group_count DESC, p.party_id ASC

SELECT
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_s.agreement_id) AS source_agreement_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca_t.agreement_id) AS target_agreement_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc
    ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
JOIN credit_agreement ca_s
    ON ca_s.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca_t
    ON ca_t.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方'
GROUP BY
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id
ORDER BY
    (COUNT(DISTINCT ca_s.agreement_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT ca_t.agreement_id)) DESC;

SELECT ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, ca.collateral_type
FROM collateral_asset ca
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM collateral_link cl
      WHERE cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
        AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
ORDER BY ca.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT gc_agg.total_guaranteed), 2) AS 有效保证责任合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(loan_agg.total_loan, 0), 2) AS 自身贷款金额,
    ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT gc_agg.total_guaranteed) - COALESCE(loan_agg.total_loan, 0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM party p
JOIN (
    SELECT gc.guarantor_party_id, SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
) gc_agg ON gc_agg.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ca.borrower_party_id, SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) loan_agg ON loan_agg.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gc_agg.total_guaranteed > COALESCE(loan_agg.total_loan, 0)
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, loan_agg.total_loan
ORDER BY 超额担保金额 DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    gc.guaranteed_amount AS 保证金额,
    gc.status AS 保证状态
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM loan_drawdown ld
      JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
      JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
      WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
        AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
        AND ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
  )
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs
    ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma
    ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.agreement_id IN (
        SELECT ca.agreement_id
        FROM credit_agreement ca
        WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = ma.obligor_party_id
    )
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds
    ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
  AND ma.obligor_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND ds.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY wp.product_name ASC, total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    sa.security_type AS security_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.security_id) AS security_count,
    ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS total_covered_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY total_covered_amount DESC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = so.security_id AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) > 0
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) > 0
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM institution i
JOIN exposure_group eg ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    AND ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value), 2) AS inversion_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS inversion_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE phs.fair_value IS NOT NULL
  AND phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY inversion_amount DESC, wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    ROUND(phs.carrying_amount, 2) AS carrying_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp
    ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma
    ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
JOIN party p
    ON p.party_id = ma.issuer_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    AND ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds
    ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
  AND ds.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY phs.holding_id, wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, phs.lookthrough_depth, phs.carrying_amount
ORDER BY phs.lookthrough_depth DESC, phs.holding_id ASC

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_priority_active_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_60_count
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.lien_priority = 1
  AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY over_60_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities, 2) AS total_liabilities,
    ROUND(fs.net_assets, 2) AS net_assets,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue, 2) AS annual_revenue
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY fs.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(
        SUM(fs.total_liabilities) * 1.0 / SUM(fs.total_assets),
        4
    ) AS debt_to_asset_ratio
FROM financial_snapshot fs
JOIN institution i
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY debt_to_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS tier1_capital_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets IS NOT NULL
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets <> 0
ORDER BY tier1_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || cs.institution_id
    AND fs.as_of_date = cs.as_of_date
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY net_capital_to_total_assets_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(fs.annual_revenue), 2) AS total_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(fs.annual_revenue) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(fs2.annual_revenue) FROM financial_snapshot fs2), 6) AS revenue_ratio
FROM financial_snapshot fs
JOIN institution i ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(fs.annual_revenue) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(fs2.annual_revenue) FROM financial_snapshot fs2) > 0.15
ORDER BY revenue_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS inconsistent_asset_count
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.internal_rating <> ma.external_rating
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY inconsistent_asset_count DESC;

SELECT
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE phs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 3
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC;

SELECT
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = 'FIXED'
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') BETWEEN 0 AND 30
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_id AS 机构编号,
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS 少计提总额,
    ROUND(fs.net_assets, 2) AS 净资产,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets, 2) AS 少计提占净资产百分比
FROM provision_snapshot p
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = p.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE p.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets
HAVING SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY 少计提占净资产百分比 DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT cg.grade_name_zh AS 风险分类名称,
       COUNT(*) AS 借据数量
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE rc.classification_basis = 'MANUAL'
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 借据数量 DESC, 风险分类名称 ASC;

SELECT
    ca.institution_id AS institution_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS nonperforming_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || ca.institution_id AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
GROUP BY ca.institution_id
HAVING SUM(ds.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / fs.annual_revenue > 0.5
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    ROUND(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets * 100, 2) AS loan_to_rwa_pct
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN credit_agreement ca
    ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i
    ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs
    ON cs.institution_id = ca.institution_id
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY loan_to_rwa_pct DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    pi.payment_mode,
    COUNT(*) AS pending_instruction_count
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY pending_instruction_count DESC, pi.payment_mode ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS exception_record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pm.amount_value), 2) AS exception_amount,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(fs.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(pm.amount_value) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital * 100, 4) AS pct_of_net_capital
FROM prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 pm
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = pm.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs
    ON cs.institution_id = pm.institution_id
   AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN financial_snapshot fs
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || pm.institution_id
   AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE pm.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY pm.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital, fs.total_assets
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8
ORDER BY pct_of_net_capital DESC;

WITH provision_shortfall AS (
    SELECT
        ld.loan_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        MAX(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) AS shortfall_amount
    FROM provision_snapshot ps
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
    GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ca.institution_id
),
regulatory_overdue AS (
    SELECT
        institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS overdue_record_count,
        AVG(amount_value) AS avg_amount
    FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3
    WHERE deadline_date < '2026-06-30'
      AND (completion_date IS NULL OR completion_date > deadline_date)
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ro.overdue_record_count,
    ROUND(ro.avg_amount, 2) AS avg_amount,
    COUNT(psf.loan_id) AS shortfall_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(psf.shortfall_amount), 2) AS total_shortfall_amount
FROM regulatory_overdue ro
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ro.institution_id
LEFT JOIN provision_shortfall psf ON psf.institution_id = ro.institution_id
WHERE ro.overdue_record_count >= 25
GROUP BY i.institution_name, ro.overdue_record_count, ro.avg_amount
ORDER BY total_shortfall_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS facility_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN g.exception_flag = 1 THEN g.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS abnormal_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(g.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN governance_control_record_v3 g ON g.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN g.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
ORDER BY abnormal_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS 关联目标主体数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS 关系种类数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh <> '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 非非关联方关系笔数
FROM related_transaction_record_v3 rtr
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = rtr.subject_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = rtr.subject_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE rtr.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联目标主体数 DESC, 关系种类数 DESC, 客户名称 ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS cardholder_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND o.exception_flag = 1 THEN o.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS abnormal_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status_code = 'ACTIVE' THEN o.record_id END) AS valid_op_risk_count
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN account a ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN operational_risk_event_v3 o ON o.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status_code = 'ACTIVE' THEN o.record_id END) >= 43
ORDER BY abnormal_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS on_sale_product_count,
    ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS total_actual_raise_amount,
    COUNT(pce.record_id) AS product_conduct_record_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pce.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio_value
FROM institution i
JOIN wealth_product wp
    ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
    AND wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
JOIN product_conduct_event_v3 pce
    ON pce.institution_id = i.institution_id
    AND pce.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(pce.record_id) >= 2
ORDER BY total_actual_raise_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS asset_count,
    ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT coe.record_id) AS custody_valid_count,
    ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT CASE WHEN coe.exception_flag = 1 THEN coe.amount_value END), 2) AS exception_amount
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN custody_operation_event_v3 coe ON coe.institution_id = i.institution_id AND coe.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN coe.exception_flag = 1 THEN coe.record_id END) >= 2
ORDER BY total_issued_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
